CFP-01.name: Webhook authenticity
CFP-01.risk: Unauthenticated provider data changes financial state
CFP-01.invariant: Invalid or missing Razorpay signature is rejected before processing

CFP-02.name: Provider event idempotency
CFP-02.risk: Provider retries same webhook and RecoveryIQ applies effect twice
CFP-02.invariant: same x-razorpay-event-id replay is acknowledged safely without duplicate financial effect

CFP-03.name: Execution idempotency / reservation
CFP-03.risk: Worker retry creates multiple Payment Links or duplicate external execution
CFP-03.invariant: one durable execution reservation prevents duplicate provider calls for the same logical execution

CFP-04.name: Payment correlation invariants
CFP-04.risk: Recovery for one payment/case is attributed to another
CFP-04.invariant: Mismatch in amount, currency, or reference fails closed and creates no attribution

CFP-05.name: Provider truth triangulation
CFP-05.risk: Signed webhook claims payment but independent provider truth contradicts it
CFP-05.invariant: CONFIRMED status requires matching independent provider state; MISMATCH blocks outcome

CFP-06.name: External outcome uniqueness
CFP-06.risk: Same provider success produces multiple local financial outcomes
CFP-06.invariant: Provider success replay yields exactly one ExternalOutcome

CFP-07.name: Recovery attribution exactly once
CFP-07.invariant: Exactly-once local recovery attribution semantics per case

CFP-08.name: Non-success payment states
CFP-08.risk: RecoveryIQ marks revenue recovered when payment did not fully succeed
CFP-08.invariant: Expired, cancelled, or partial payments produce no successful attribution

CFP-09.name: Subscription.charged recovery
CFP-09.risk: A legitimate recurring charge is mis-correlated or counted incorrectly
CFP-09.invariant: subscription.charged safely and independently recovers correctly correlated cases exactly once

CFP-10.name: Execution authority
CFP-10.risk: Operator action is represented as autonomous model execution
CFP-10.invariant: OPERATOR_INITIATED execution safely records autonomous=false separate from provenance

CFP-11.name: Unknown provider outcome / crash ambiguity
CFP-11.risk: Network failure occurs after provider may have accepted execution, causing blind retries
CFP-11.invariant: Unknown outcomes are partially protected and safely block immediate blind replays

CFP-12.name: Evidence does not create financial truth
CFP-12.risk: Recovery Proof endpoint accidentally mutates financial state
CFP-12.invariant: Recovery proof is strictly read-only and does not persist confirmation records
